pre-fix-yarn.authenticity: "pick up the bill", "mate’s daughter" and "shouting" are natural local terms.
pre-fix-yarn.register: "small potatoes", "a gig" and "worth heaps" make the body a little heavier than a light level-2 treatment.
pre-fix-yarn.tone: "FINES and JAIL." retains the emphatic warning and the original Yoda joke remains in place.
pre-fix-yarn.flow: "When you put in your expense report to get reimbursed" is smooth and clear.
pre-fix-yarn.variety: "pick up the bill", "fair bit" and "cop a few years" avoid leaning on one expression.

dinkum-3.meaning: "you'll need Legal's approval in writing (each time)" and "not necessarily just for GitHub" retain obligation, threshold and consequence qualifications.

dinkum-3.register: "righto", "pressie", "choccies" and "dosh" across the whole text make this noticeably stronger than light level 2.
dinkum-3.tone: "FINES and JAIL." and "Sorry, Yoda: it’s the trying that counts." preserve the blunt warning and existing joke.
dinkum-3.flow: "When you put in your expense claim to get paid back" reads easily, and the long threshold paragraph stays coherent.
dinkum-3.variety: "pressie" and "pressies" recur, but "shout", "choccies" and "dosh" give sufficient variety overall.
dinkum-3.essence: "Legal's only weighing in on the bribery side of things" retains the distinction between bribery review and other Finance concerns.

current.meaning: "For any gift you receive worth more than $150, you’ll need to report it to Legal in writing, each time." retains the threshold, recipient, medium and repetition requirements.
current.sense: "Bleacher-type tickets" keeps the exact seating category; "shout them dinner" correctly conveys paying for dinner.
current.authenticity: "that’s not on", "fair bit" and "choccies" sound like an Australian speaking naturally.
current.register: "shout them dinner" and "a fair bit of money" give the light level-2 touch without overloading the policy.
current.tone: "And GitHub mightn’t be the only one." preserves the warning’s conditional force, and the Yoda punchline remains.
current.flow: "If she isn’t qualified and you pull strings to get her in, though, that’s not on." reads fluently aloud.
current.variety: "shout", "choccies" and "fair bit" vary the modest local vocabulary.
current.essence: "Legal is only weighing in on the bribery question" and the unchanged approval-email requirement keep the policy’s distinguishing practical character.
